name: Empty password is rejected without a request
title: SC-06-02-06 Empty password is rejected without a request
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

When the manager submits the form with an empty password
Then a validation message is shown
And no login request is sent
